clips.title: The story
paras: Maur Raincaller in Bloodhoof Village needs a Prairie Wolf Heart for a remedy against venom.

Maur Raincaller lives in Bloodhoof Village and is suffering from the venom of Mazzranache, the legendary plainstrider. The bite brings fever and threatens to spread poison through him. Maur seeks the heart of a prairie wolf, along with cougar bone and bird gizzard, for a traditional plains remedy meant to stop the infection before delirium proves fatal.
